It is also blocked while a recorded sale's statement has no box 4 amount, and while it is unanswered whether a Form 1099-B shows box 4 withholding and no closed sale, other than a statement whose box 4 was entered with its sales.
line25b_field.published_explain: Form 1040 line 25b is the total of the 1099-document withholding amounts, with cents included, rounded once to whole dollars: Forms 1099-INT, 1099-DIV and 1099-R box 4, Form 1099-G box 4, Form SSA-1099 box 6, and Form 1099-B box 4 backup withholding. That total includes backup withholding from a Form 1099-B with no closed sale, excluding an amount already entered with that statement's sales.
